description: This file is a C source code file implementing the Touchstone system integration library. It provides functions to check if Touchstone is enabled, activated, running, get/set server hostname, reset to factory, and restart services, with internal logic for configuration management and IPC communication.

methods.name: isTouchstoneEnabled
methods.description: Checks for the existence of a specific marker file to determine if Touchstone is enabled.

methods.name: touchstoneIsActivated
methods.description: Determines if Touchstone is currently activated by querying the cloud association state via IPC.

methods.name: touchstoneIsRunning
methods.description: Checks if key services like commService are running to infer if Touchstone is active.

methods.name: touchstoneGetServerHostname
methods.description: Retrieves the hostname of the server Touchstone would activate against, via IPC or configuration files.

methods.name: touchstoneSetServerHostname
methods.description: Attempts to set the server hostname via IPC; if unsuccessful, writes to a marker file for later pickup.

methods.name: restartTouchstoneGroup
methods.description: Restarts the Touchstone process group if enabled.

methods.name: touchstoneResetToFactory
methods.description: Resets Touchstone to factory defaults, then restarts services.

methods.name: touchstoneRestart
methods.description: Restarts all Touchstone services if enabled, including special handling for XB6.

methods.name: findClsCommHostConfig
methods.description: Linked list compare function to find CLS communication host config.

methods.name: findPrimaryCommHostConfig
methods.description: Linked list compare function to find primary communication host config.
